NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION
Prior to going into closed session the City Council will convene in the Auditorium serving as Council Chambers to take public comment on the closed session items only. General public comment will be provided for during the regular portion of the meeting beginning at 7:30 P.M.
1.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant to California Government Code 54956.9(d)(1). Azusa Unified School District vs. City of Azusa, et al, Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. BS157058.

Negotiating Part(ies): Any interested buyers.

NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR REGULAR MEETING
Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the Agenda are on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection at the City Library.
Persons who wish to speak during the Public Participation portion of the Agenda, shall fill out a card requesting to speak and shall submit it to the City Clerk prior to the start of the City Council meeting. When called, each person may address any item on or off the agenda during the public participation.
In compliance with Government code Section 54957.5, copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the Agenda are in file on the Office of the City Clerk - 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; copies for public view are in the Azusa City Library - 729 N. Dalton Ave., Azusa Police Department Lobby - 725 N. Alameda Ave., and the City of Azusa Web Page www.ci.azusa.ca.us. Persons who wish to speak during the Public Participation portion of the Agenda or on a Public Hearing item, shall fill out a card requesting to speak and shall submit it to the City Clerk prior to 7:30 P.M.; cards submitted after will not be accepted.
7:30 P.M. - REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
1.
Call to Order
2.
Roll Call
3.
Pledge to the Flag
4.
Invocation – Reverend Jesse Aramburo, Canyon Christian Fellowship
B.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
This time has been set aside for persons in the audience to make public comments on items within the subject matter jurisdiction of the council/agency board that are not listed on this agenda or are listed on this agenda as an item other than a public hearing item. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address the city council/agency board about public hearing items at the time the public hearing is held. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the council/agency board is prohibited from taking action on oral requests, but may refer the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting. The council/agency board will respond after public comment has been received. Each person or representative of a group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to five (5) continuous minutes, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes.
C.
REPORTS, UPDATES, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM STAFF/COUNCIL
1.
Mayor Rocha: request for a certificate congratulating Alliance Environmental Group, Inc. for celebrating their 20th anniversary.
2.
Mayor Rocha: request for a $200 sponsorship for Sierra High School to attend a field trip.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 8, 2015.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve minutes as written.
D-1 Minutes Regular Meeting, September 8
2.
RESOLUTIONS AUTHORIZING PAYMENT OF WARRANTS BY THE CITY.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution No. 2015-C55 allowing certain claims and demands and specifying the funds out of which the same are to be paid.
D-2 Resolution 2015-C55, Warrant Register
3.
HUMAN RESOURCES ACTION ITEMS.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Personnel Action Requests in accordance with the City of Azusa Civil Service Rules and applicable Memorandum of Understanding(s).
D-3 Human Resouces Action Items
4.
CITY TREASURERâ€™S STATEMENTS OF CASH AND INVESTMENT BALANCES FOR THE MONTHS OF AUGUST 2015.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive, review and file the City Treasurerâ€™s Report for the City of Azusa for the month of August 2015.
D-4 Treasurers Report, August 2015
5.
AUTHORIZATION TO ISSUE A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS TO PROVIDE FLEET MAINTENANCE SERVICES.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize staff to issue a Request for Proposals to provide fleet maintenance services.
D-5 Fleet Maintenance Services RFP
6.
APPROVE AN AMENDMENT TO THE JAIL FOOD SERVICE CONTRACT.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Amendment No. 2 to the Jail Food Service Contract with the County of Los Angeles increasing the cost per meal to $2.41 and authorize the Mayor to execute, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, Amendment No. 2, on behalf of the City of Azusa.
D-6 Jail Food Services Contract Amendment
7.
APPROVE MEMORANDUM OF AGREEEMENT WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF MENTAL HEALTH TO PARTICIPATE IN THE EAST SAN GABRIEL MENTAL EVAULATION TEAM PROJECT.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the Memorandum of Agreement and authorize the Chief of Police or City Manager to execute, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, the agreement on behalf of the City.
D-7 Memorandum of Agreement with LACODMH and ESGMET
8.
ACCEPTANCE OF PARKWAY LANDSCAPING IMPROVEMENTS SURROUNDING THE PARSONS PLACE NEIGHBORHOOD IN THE IN THE PROMENADE DISTRICT OF ROSEDALE.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Accept the parkway improvements surrounding the Parsons Place neighborhood in the Promenade District, located along the north side of 9th street, the east side of Azusa Veterans Way, the south side of The Promenade, and the west side of Rosedale Ave and approve an amendment to the existing contract between the City and ValleyCrest Landscape Maintenance increasing the contract amount by $670 per month to maintain the additional parkways.
D-8 Acceptance of Parkway Landscape Improvements
E.
